member.name: T:Nickelony.LanguageServer.Lua.ILuaIntelliSenseProvider
member.summary: Defines the Lua-specific language-service contract used by the Lua editor to provide IntelliSense features.
member.remarks:
This interface extends with Lua-specific concerns such as semantic tokens. The generic document lifecycle, diagnostics, completion, hover, definition, and signature-help contracts are defined on the base interface.
Implementations may raise callbacks from background threads. Consumers that access UI controls must marshal those callbacks to the UI thread. Once disposal begins, no further provider callbacks are raised.

member.name: E:Nickelony.LanguageServer.Lua.ILuaIntelliSenseProvider.SemanticTokensUpdated
member.summary: Occurs when semantic tokens for a document have changed.
member.remarks: This callback may be raised from a background thread. UI consumers must marshal to the UI thread before touching controls. Handlers for one event invocation run serially on the raising thread; a failing handler is isolated from later handlers. The semantic-token list and each token's modifier list are owned immutable snapshots that remain valid after the callback returns. Once disposal begins, this event will not be raised again.
